title: Decision keys not found: skip test-fixture citations, or treat `_test.go` files apart from other files

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261127-183724-914b for S537 (discovered from S537):

Decision keys not found: skip test-fixture citations, or treat `_test.go` files apart from other files
Test fixtures are scanned as citations. My probe on this slice's own untracked `decisionkeys_test.go` found 10 keys, starting with `a.first`, `a.header`, `b.middle` and `c.context`. Every one would be listed as not found in this slice's own reviewer and gate briefs. Any future slice that tests citation-shaped strings gets the same noise. adj 640 does not exclude test files, so changing this is the owner's call in a follow-up.
Importance: 2
